title: Sister city ties with Ilocos Norte capital
summary: The committee deferred the sister city item on October 20, 2026, leaving it for later. The council adopted a resolution on September 29, 2026 making the capital city of Ilocos Norte, Philippines, a sister city. The next step is signing a memorandum of agreement, followed by a ceremonial gathering.

timeline.text: The chair asked about sending a letter to the Sister City Foundation for its list of cities waiting to be considered.

timeline.text: He suggested an ad hoc committee (a special working group) to explore more ideas.

timeline.text: A community council presenter named four areas for ties: tourism and culture, agriculture, trade, and education and health.
timeline.body: County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

timeline.text: A County official said a ceremonial gathering will follow the signing of the memorandum of agreement.
